alex.m: FYI: found a redaction gap in the node sampleapp when toggling log-level via feature flag — request IDs are leaked on 2nd fetch retry. Minimal repro steps below.

alex.m: ```
1) deploy sampleapp w/ LOG_LEVEL=info and otel hooks enabled
2) flip feature flag to DEBUG (runtime)
3) trigger failing downstream call -> retry kicks in (node-fetch retry wrapper)
4) observe stderr: request-id printed unredacted on retry
```

priya: uh oh. does this only happen with runtime toggles? or also env-level restart?

alex.m: Only observed on runtime toggle (no restart). env restart respects redaction. Seems like redaction middleware reads level at init and then doesn't get applied when logger emits at a different level.

samira: possible hook ordering issue between our OpenTelemetry log hook and logger-level toggle. when the log hook redacts, it reads logger config at init — might race.

marcus: can you paste the exact log lines? also which logger (pino/winston) + version?

alex.m: ```
ERROR sampleapp request failed: 500 {"user":"u123", "request_id":"req_ABC123", "err":"timeout"}
DEBUG retrying request (attempt=2) request_id=req_ABC123
```

priya: interesting: DEBUG line contains raw request_id as inline token, not as structured kv. could be our retry wrapper adding header into message template before redaction hook runs.

alex.m: Yep. retry wrapper currently does: `logger.debug(`retrying request (attempt=${i}) request_id=${ctx.reqId}`)` — that bypasses structured fields, so redaction (which runs on structured metadata) misses it.

samira: so root cause = redaction hook only scans metadata object and structured fields, not raw message string. fix options: run redaction on formatted message string too, or force retry wrapper to log reqId as metadata (logger.debug(msg, { reqId })).

priya: also noticed otel traceparent is lost across retries in this flow — new trace created and retry wrapper appends reqId into message, making it present in logs even when metadata would be redacted.

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-4932 telemetry redaction bypass on runtime log-level toggles — assignee: devex.ack

marcus: @alex.m can you add a minimal repro under sampleapps/telemetry-repro and open a draft PR? i can take the redaction lib change if you want.

alex.m: Will open PR w/ test + sampleapp. short-term mitigation: pin runtime log-level change to require restart OR change retry wrapper to attach reqId as metadata not inline string.

devex-bot: :thumbsup: Added labels: bug, telemetry, sdk-node

priya: also flagging parity work — python sdk already redacts raw message strings + metadata, node needs to match. marking as sdk-parity and telemetry-refactor.
